moved_keys.name: every_key
moved_keys.message:
config uses keys that moved or were removed (YAML paths; as env vars they are DK_ plus the path with "__"; see docs/upgrading.md):
  ui.recorder.db_dir -> storage.dir
  ui.recorder.archive_enabled -> history.archive.enabled
  ui.recorder.archive_window_hours -> history.archive.window_hours
  ui.recorder.archive_retention_days -> history.archive.retention_days
  ui.workers_offline_after_seconds -> fleet.registry.offline_after_seconds
  cache.peer_sync.enabled -> fleet.cache_exchange.enabled
  cache.peer_sync.interval_seconds -> fleet.cache_exchange.interval_seconds
  cache.peer_sync.batch_size -> fleet.cache_exchange.page_size
  cache.peer_sync.timeout_seconds -> fleet.cache_exchange.timeout_seconds
  cache.peer_sync.cycle_deadline_seconds -> fleet.cache_exchange.cycle_deadline_seconds
  cache.db_dir: removed, the cache file lives in storage.dir
  ui.recorder.dbstats_warm_interval_seconds: removed, database statistics are no longer cached in a shared file
  ui.recorder.dbstats_inline_scan_limit: removed, database statistics are no longer cached in a shared file
  fleet.registry.timeout_seconds -> fleet.registry.resilience.timeout_seconds
  history.archive.election -> periodic.election
  history.archive.lock_stale_seconds -> history.archive.lease_seconds (the lease) and history.archive.sweep_after_seconds (the age of work files to sweep)
  history.archive.pass_interval_seconds -> history.archive.interval (a slot schedule; no pass after each rotation)

validation.name: window_shorter_than_rotation
validation.message: history.archive.window_hours (1) must be >= ui.recorder.rotation_interval_hours (2)

validation.name: due_shorter_than_rotation
validation.message: history.archive.due_after_hours (1) must be >= ui.recorder.rotation_interval_hours (2)

validation.name: retention_too_short
validation.message: history.archive.retention_days (2) must be 0 (keep archives forever) or cover the due delay plus one window: retention_days * 24 must be >= history.archive.due_after_hours (48) + history.archive.window_hours (24).

validation.name: retention_default_note
validation.message: history.archive.retention_days (30) must be 0 (keep archives forever) or cover the due delay plus one window: retention_days * 24 must be >= history.archive.due_after_hours (48) + history.archive.window_hours (720). The value is the 30-day default, so raise it (or set 0 to keep archives forever) to go with a window this wide.

validation.name: offline_below_two_heartbeats
validation.message: fleet.registry.offline_after_seconds (30) must be >= 2 * fleet.registry.heartbeat_seconds (20)

validation.name: prune_below_offline
validation.message: fleet.registry.prune_after_seconds (10) must be >= fleet.registry.offline_after_seconds (30)

validation.name: deadline_not_below_interval
validation.message: fleet.cache_exchange.cycle_deadline_seconds (10) must be strictly less than fleet.cache_exchange.interval_seconds (10) — otherwise the deadline can never fire before the next cycle schedules.

validation.name: deadline_fractional_values
validation.message: fleet.cache_exchange.cycle_deadline_seconds (3.5) must be strictly less than fleet.cache_exchange.interval_seconds (2.5) — otherwise the deadline can never fire before the next cycle schedules.

validation.name: offline_below_floor
validation.message: fleet.registry.offline_after_seconds (5) must be >= 10
